storage.description: Storage backend name: 'file' (built in), or one provided by an installed backend mod such as 'sqlite', 'postgres', 's3'.

path.description: Filesystem directory (file backend) or database file path (sqlite backend).

bucket.description: Bucket name for the s3 backend.

prefix.description: Key prefix for the s3 backend.

chunkSize.description: Number of ticks grouped into one stored chunk (must match the client's expectation; default 100).

keepTicks.description: Retention window in ticks; chunks older than this are pruned (0 disables pruning).

cleanupInterval.description: How often, in ticks, to run the retention sweep.

capture.description: Whether this backend instance records history. Disable on extra backends to keep a single writer.
